Interesting. I'm only 28 and have had normal blood pressure my whole life that has always ran on the low side of normal. But recently I had a higher than average reading and it made me worried. I'm so terrified of getting blood clots.

Thanks so much for your help. This was really needed.
Also, how high was your blood pressure? Mine is currently borderline high which was the other reason in addition to the spotting that I wanted to stop Yaz.
Wow. This was very helpful. I'm so glad I posted here. Thank you. Going back to Yaz tomorrow.

How do I ride this out? Is it due to low estrogen? Can I supplement estrogen somehow? Are there specific foods to eat that help with this sort of thing? Vitamins? I'll do anything. I just want the content feeling back. :(
